summary: The retained receipt (43a04622beef40588679c6cf1c40d6ad) reproduced the predicted difference exactly: on the re-added voter (node 3, voter=true, leader 1 unchanged) Propose had not returned after 1200 ms (index 7), ended only with 'context deadline exceeded' at the caller's 2500 ms deadline (index 8), and its payload never reached any node's committed entries (index 9); the never-removed member returned in 0 ms and committed (indices 11, 12), and the same node 3 call returned in 0 ms and committed after a forced leader change (indices 13, 15, 16). Interpretation-0 is revised to evidence-backed 'holds' with defect asserted, the open gap is answered (the only gate assignments are node.go:374/377/426; re-admission has no re-arm path, so responsibility lies with the node wrapper), and the framework's earlier 'unknown' comparison outcomes are explained as a harness artifact: all three operations shared result-event names, so each comparison also evaluated the others' events. A successor experiment with per-operation event names is submitted for fresh execution; all seven comparisons evaluate as complete holds when checked locally with the framework's own comparator (the retained successor receipt will replace the artifact-limited outcome).
